name: Boys Ranch Town | Residential Care for Boys
snippet:
Located in Edmond, OK , we provide a free, faith-based home for boys ages 6–17 facing challenges. Helping young men to flourish. Apply.
Our homes for boys are designed for youth who need a stable environment due to family crises, financial struggles, or a lack of adult supervision. To join the program, a child must be willing to accept help and function well in a standard public school setting.
